procedures.title: Natural Death at Home Certification and Handover Protocol
procedures.summary: Mandatory statutory and medical workflow for natural, expected deaths occurring at a private residence in Singapore. Requires clinical verification by a registered medical practitioner, digital CCOD submission, and licensed funeral director conveyance.
trigger_conditions: Deceased passed away at a private residential home due to known, terminal, or natural medical causes.
A registered family doctor, home hospice/palliative physician, or 24/7 house-call doctor is available to conduct physical death certification.
There are no signs of trauma, foul play, violence, poisoning, or sudden unexplainable cessation of life.

immediate_actions.action: Remain calm and verify the absence of vital signs (breathing, pulse, responsiveness). Do not panic or disturb the immediate room arrangement.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: DO NOT move the body to another room, wash the body, or alter clothing before the certifying doctor completes the physical examination.

immediate_actions.action: Contact the deceased's regular attending physician, home hospice team (e.g., HCA Hospice, Dover Park Home Care), or Solace Dignity Care's 24-hour doctor house-call dispatch service (+65 6555 1115) to perform on-site death certification.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: If no doctor is willing or able to certify the cause of death based on recent medical history, the case must legally be reported to the Singapore Police Force (999).

immediate_actions.action: Gather the deceased's original identification document (NRIC, FIN, or Passport), recent hospital discharge summaries, specialist outpatient memos, and the informant's original NRIC.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Original physical identity cards are strictly required by the certifying doctor; photocopies or digital screenshots are not accepted for physical verification.

immediate_actions.action: Upon completion of clinical examination and digital CCOD submission by the doctor, call Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) for transfer of remains, embalming, and wake logistics.

documentation_required.purpose: Mandatory identity verification by the certifying medical practitioner.
Establishes legal next-of-kin status and enters informant record in the National Registry.

documentation_required.document_name: Recent Medical History / Discharge Summary / Specialist Memos
documentation_required.issued_by: Attending Hospital / Specialist Medical Centre / Hospice
documentation_required.purpose: Provides clinical substantiation enabling the doctor to certify natural cause of death without referring to the State Coroner.

documentation_required.issued_by: Certifying Registered Medical Practitioner (via MOH / ICA Portal)
documentation_required.purpose: Statutory medical document registering the cause of death electronically into the national death registry.

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA (via My Legacy Portal)
documentation_required.purpose: Official legal proof of death required to book wake venues, crematorium/burial slots, and permit body transport.

workflow_steps.description: Family confirms passing and contacts regular attending GP, palliative care team, or SDC 24-hour house-call doctor hotline (+65 6555 1115).
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Physical arrival of the registered medical practitioner at the residence.

workflow_steps.description: Doctor conducts clinical assessment, reviews past medical records, confirms natural cause of death, and verifies identity against original NRIC.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Successful determination that death is natural and non-coronial.

workflow_steps.description: Doctor uploads the electronic Cause of Death Certificate (CCOD) directly to the ICA Registry of Births and Deaths portal.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Instantaneous generation of Digital Death Certificate by ICA.

workflow_steps.description: Next-of-Kin receives SMS notification and logs into My Legacy portal (mylegacy.life.gov.sg) using Singpass to download official Digital Death Certificate PDF.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Handover of Digital Death Certificate to Solace Dignity Care.

workflow_steps.description: Solace Dignity Care transfer team arrives at the residence, secures the body in a specialized body bag, conveys remains to the embalming care centre, and initiates town council / parlour wake setup.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Embalming sanitization, dressing, and casket placement for wake.

HCA Hospice Care 24/7 Hotline

procedures.title: Inpatient Hospital Passing and Mortuary Clearance Protocol
procedures.summary: Structured protocol for deaths occurring within restructured or private hospital inpatient wards, intensive care units (ICU), or emergency departments where the attending doctor certifies cause of death.
trigger_conditions: Patient certified deceased while admitted to a Singapore restructured hospital (e.g., SGH, NUH, TTSH, CGH, KTPH, SKH, NTFGH) or private hospital (e.g., Mount Elizabeth, Gleneagles, Parkway East, Raffles Hospital, Mount Alvernia).
Ward doctor or attending consultant confirms natural cause of death linked to diagnosed illness.
Body transferred from ward to the hospital's internal mortuary pending family collection.

immediate_actions.action: Ward nursing staff perform preliminary post-mortem care (nursing last offices) and prepare the deceased for internal transfer to the hospital mortuary holding room.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Personal valuables and jewellery on the deceased are inventoried; family must verify and sign the property release form.

immediate_actions.action: Attending ward doctor enters the electronic CCOD directly into the national registry, triggering the generation of the Digital Death Certificate via My Legacy.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: If death occurs during surgery, within 24 hours of admission, or under unexplained circumstances, the hospital is legally mandated to refer the case to the State Coroner.

immediate_actions.action: Next-of-Kin receives hospital death memo, settles administrative ward discharge, and downloads Digital Death Certificate via Singpass on My Legacy portal.
Contact Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) and provide the Digital Death Certificate and signed Letter of Authorization for hospital mortuary collection.

documentation_required.purpose: Authorizes administrative release of the body from the hospital ward/mortuary.

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA (via My Legacy Portal)
documentation_required.purpose: Legal verification of death and mandatory prerequisite for funeral director body collection.
Mortuary security clearance and identity cross-matching.
Verification of next-of-kin identity for releasing body and personal effects.

documentation_required.document_name: Funeral Director Authorization Letter for Body Release
documentation_required.purpose: Statutory power of attorney empowering Solace Dignity Care transport staff to collect remains from hospital mortuary.

workflow_steps.description: Medical officer confirms time of death. Nurses perform last offices, tag the body, and arrange porterage to the hospital mortuary cold room.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Submission of electronic CCOD by ward doctor.

workflow_steps.description: Hospital electronic CCOD uploads to ICA. Informant receives automated SMS alert to download Digital Death Certificate via My Legacy.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Next-of-Kin Singpass login and document download.

workflow_steps.description: Family provides Digital Death Certificate and signs authorization letter for Solace Dignity Care.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: SDC logistics dispatch to hospital mortuary.

workflow_steps.description: SDC collection crew attends hospital mortuary counter, presents required documents, verifies body tag with mortuary technician, and conveys body to embalming facility.

emergency_contacts.agency: Solace Dignity Care 24/7 Hospital Transfer Division
Singapore General Hospital (SGH) Mortuary
National University Hospital (NUH) Mortuary
Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) Mortuary

special_handling.notes: Hospital mortuaries provide complimentary storage up to 24-48 hours. SDC arranges immediate collection within 60 to 90 minutes of receiving family authorization.

procedures.title: Nursing Home and Residential Care Facility Passing Protocol
procedures.summary: Operational protocol for residents passing away in institutional aged care, nursing homes, or hospices in Singapore, including attending doctor verification and direct facility handover.
trigger_conditions: Resident passes away at an MOH-licensed nursing home (e.g., Ren Ci, St. Andrew's, Econ Healthcare, Orange Valley, All Saints Home, NTUC Health) or community care facility.
Facility's panel physician, visiting medical officer, or home-care doctor certifies natural death.

immediate_actions.action: Nursing supervisor on duty contacts the appointed primary Next-of-Kin (NOK) and alerts the facility's attending panel doctor.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Nursing homes have strictly limited holding space and no long-term cold refrigeration. Body retrieval must occur within 2 to 4 hours of certification.

immediate_actions.action: Attending doctor conducts physical examination at the facility, certifies cause of death, and submits CCOD electronically to ICA.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Attending Panel Physician / Visiting Medical Officer

immediate_actions.action: Next-of-Kin downloads Digital Death Certificate from My Legacy (mylegacy.life.gov.sg) using Singpass and contacts Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) for immediate collection.
Informant and SDC transfer team reconcile and sign the nursing home's resident personal effects inventory register and handover log.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Next-of-Kin / SDC Funeral Crew / Facility Staff

documentation_required.purpose: Identity verification by visiting doctor and funeral director.
Confirms passing of resident and authorizes release of body and property.

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA (via My Legacy Portal)
documentation_required.purpose: Statutory requirement for conveyance, embalming, and booking wake/cremation venues.

documentation_required.document_name: Facility Body Release & Property Handover Form
documentation_required.purpose: Legal indemnification and formal release of resident remains to authorized funeral director.

workflow_steps.description: Duty nurses identify cessation of life, contact family, and request visiting panel physician to certify death.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Arrival and clinical assessment by doctor.

workflow_steps.description: Doctor uploads electronic CCOD to ICA. Digital Death Certificate becomes accessible on My Legacy portal.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Singpass retrieval of PDF Death Certificate.

workflow_steps.description: Solace Dignity Care dispatches dedicated transfer vehicle and crew to the nursing home within 45-60 minutes.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Verification of body tag and clearance by nursing home supervisor.

workflow_steps.description: SDC crew secures remains, collects belongings, signs facility registers, and transfers deceased to SDC embalming facility or cold holding.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Family wake planning and permit applications.

emergency_contacts.agency: Solace Dignity Care Rapid Dispatch Unit
Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) Healthcare Hotline

special_handling.notes: Because nursing home holding facilities are unrefrigerated, SDC prioritizes urgent transfer to our centralized temperature-controlled holding facility to preserve dignified condition.

procedures.title: Sudden, Unattended, or Unnatural Death Emergency Police Protocol
procedures.summary: Legal and emergency procedures triggered when a person dies suddenly, unexpectedly, without recent medical supervision, or under unnatural/suspicious circumstances in Singapore.
trigger_conditions: Death occurs suddenly at a residence or public location with no prior diagnosed terminal illness.
No registered doctor is willing or legally able to certify the cause of death.
Suspected suicide, unnatural death, traffic/industrial fatal accident, fall from height, drowning, poisoning, or violence.

immediate_actions.action: Immediately dial 999 for the Singapore Police Force (SPF). If resuscitation is remotely possible or uncertain, dial 995 for SCDF Emergency Ambulance.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: DO NOT touch, move, wash, change clothing, or disturb the deceased or surrounding objects, notes, medications, or furniture.

immediate_actions.action: Secure the premises and preserve the physical scene intact until Police Land Division officers and Crime Scene Specialists arrive.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Tampering with a death scene or attempting unauthorized transport is a serious criminal offense under Singapore law.

immediate_actions.action: Cooperate fully with the attending Police Investigation Officer (IO), provide witness statements, and furnish all known past medical records, prescriptions, and clinic appointments.
Receive the Police Investigation Slip / Case Information Card from the attending IO upon completion of on-site forensics.
Police Hearse conveys the deceased directly to Mortuary@HSA (Block 9, Singapore General Hospital Complex). Family is instructed to report to Mortuary@HSA the following morning at 08:00 AM.

documentation_required.purpose: Formal identification by Police Investigation Officer and Mortuary@HSA.
Recording official police witness statement and next-of-kin particulars.

documentation_required.document_name: Police Investigation Slip / Case Reference Card
documentation_required.purpose: Case reference required for entry and registration at Mortuary@HSA the next morning.
Assists the State Coroner and Forensic Pathologist in determining whether an autopsy is mandatory.

workflow_steps.description: Informant calls SPF 999. Police dispatch fast-response patrol cars, investigation officers, and forensics to the location.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Arrival of Police Land Division officers.

workflow_steps.description: Officers cordon the area, photograph the scene, interview informants, and inspect medication bottles and personal belongings.
Official Police Hearse transfers the deceased to Mortuary@HSA (Block 9, SGH Complex). Private funeral hearses are legally prohibited from transporting the body at this stage.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Admission of remains into Mortuary@HSA forensic cold storage.

workflow_steps.description: Attending IO briefs family, issues case card, and provides reporting instructions for Mortuary@HSA attendance at 08:00 AM the next day.

emergency_contacts.agency: Singapore Police Force (Emergency)
Singapore Civil Defence Force (Paramedic Emergency)
Singapore Police Force (Non-Emergency Hotline)
Solace Dignity Care Crisis Support Liaison

special_handling.notes: STRICT STATUTORY WARNING: Embalming, cleaning, or unauthorized conveyance is strictly prohibited by law until the State Coroner issues the formal Digital Death Certificate and Burial/Cremation Permit.

procedures.title: State Coroner Inquiry and Judicial Review Protocol
procedures.summary: Formal legal framework governing deaths falling under the jurisdiction of the Coroners Act 2010 (Cap. 63A) in Singapore, managed by the State Courts and Police Division Investigation Officers.
trigger_conditions: Death is violent, unnatural, sudden with cause unknown, or occurring in official custody (prison, police lockup, detention centre).
Death resulting from surgical, medical, or anaesthetic misadventure.
Medical practitioner files a mandatory Form 1 notification under Section 14 of the Coroners Act.

immediate_actions.action: Police Division Investigation Officer (IO) takes statutory custody of the case file and decedent under the direction of the State Coroner.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: No individual, doctor, or family member can override Coroner jurisdiction once triggered.

immediate_actions.action: Duty State Coroner reviews the preliminary police report, circumstances of death, and past medical history to decide if a full post-mortem autopsy, external examination, or toxicology is ordered under Section 24.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Duty State Coroner (State Courts of Singapore)

immediate_actions.action: Next-of-Kin attends the Coroner's briefing at Mortuary@HSA / Police Cantonment Complex, submits any written representations, and assists in establishing medical history.
Upon conclusion of the post-mortem assessment, the State Coroner signs off on the cause of death, releases the body, and issues the Digital Death Certificate and Permit to Bury/Cremate.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: State Coroner / HSA Forensic Medicine Division

documentation_required.purpose: Judicial warrant authorizing forensic pathologists at HSA to conduct external or invasive post-mortem examination.

documentation_required.document_name: Coroner's Certificate of Cause of Death (Form 4)
documentation_required.purpose: Official judicial determination of cause of death.

documentation_required.document_name: State Coroner's Permit to Bury or Cremate
documentation_required.purpose: Mandatory legal clearance permitting Solace Dignity Care to collect remains and book Mandai Crematorium or cemetery.
Legal affidavit confirming the physical identity of the deceased by primary next-of-kin.

workflow_steps.description: Case transferred to the State Courts Coroners Court docket. IO compiles police investigation dossier and transmits to the Duty Coroner.
State Coroner issues formal direction to HSA Forensic Medicine Division regarding post-mortem scope (Full Autopsy vs. External Inspection vs. Post-Mortem CT Virtopsy).
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Execution of pathology examination at Block 9 HSA.

workflow_steps.description: Coroner evaluates pathologist findings, establishes cause of death, and electronically approves the Digital Death Certificate and Burial/Cremation Permit.

workflow_steps.phase: Body Release to Authorized Funeral Director
workflow_steps.description: Coroner's office releases body claim authorization to Solace Dignity Care upon verification of family Letter of Authorization.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Conveyance of body by SDC hearse team.

emergency_contacts.agency: State Courts - Coroners Court Registry
Police Cantonment Complex (CID Investigation Desk)
Solace Dignity Care Legal & Police Liaison Desk

special_handling.notes: The State Coroner has exclusive judicial authority. Neither family members nor private lawyers can bypass post-mortem orders if criminal suspicion exists. SDC provides specialized family guidance throughout the inquiry process.

procedures.title: Forensic and Clinical Post-Mortem Examination Protocol
procedures.summary: Comprehensive guidelines detailing mandatory forensic autopsies ordered by the State Coroner versus non-coroner clinical autopsies requested by physicians or families in Singapore.
trigger_conditions: State Coroner issues an order for post-mortem examination under Section 24 of the Coroners Act to establish the medical cause of death.
Clinical/Pathological autopsy requested by hospital attending consultant with next-of-kin informed consent for academic or medical research review.

immediate_actions.action: Health Sciences Authority (HSA) Forensic Medicine Division admits decedent into the post-mortem suite at Block 9, SGH Complex.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Family members are not permitted inside the autopsy dissection theater.

immediate_actions.action: Next-of-Kin may submit medical history or religious representations regarding invasive post-mortems to the Coroner's Officer during morning interview.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: While religious sensitivities are respected where possible, statutory Coroner autopsies override family refusal if foul play or public interest is involved.

immediate_actions.action: Forensic Pathologist performs comprehensive examination (external inspection, post-mortem CT Virtopsy scan, toxicological sampling, and/or internal organ dissection).
Pathologist formulates interim cause of death, performs anatomical reconstruction and hygienic suture closure of the body, and submits findings to the State Coroner.

documentation_required.purpose: Legal authorization for forensic examination.
Clinical and anatomical findings outlining primary, secondary, and contributory causes of death.
Chemical and microscopic analysis (standard processing takes 6 to 12 weeks, but body release is granted promptly on interim findings).
Confirms completion of post-mortem and authorizes release to funeral director.

workflow_steps.description: Remains undergo barcode registration and post-mortem Computed Tomography (Virtopsy) scan to assess skeletal fractures and internal hemorrhages non-invasively.
Pathologist performs internal examination and collects blood, vitreous, and tissue specimens for toxicology where required.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Completion of surgical reconstruction and suturing.

workflow_steps.description: Mortuary technicians reconstruct, wash, and suture remains with high dignity and aesthetic care to allow open-casket viewing during subsequent wake.

workflow_steps.phase: Release Clearance to Solace Dignity Care
workflow_steps.description: Mortuary counter clears the case for claim. SDC licensed embalmers collect body for restorative makeup and wake preparation.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: SDC vehicle transfer to care facility.

emergency_contacts.agency: HSA Forensic Medicine Division General Counter
Mortuary@HSA Case Status Information Line
Solace Dignity Care Forensic Support Team

special_handling.notes: Post-mortem examinations generally take 12 to 24 hours. Once released by HSA, embalming is fully permitted. Solace Dignity Care employs certified restorative embalmers experienced in post-autopsy restorative cosmetology for open-casket viewings.

procedures.title: Mortuary@HSA (Block 9) Physical Identification and Body Claim Protocol
procedures.summary: Step-by-step procedural manual for next-of-kin navigating physical identification, coroner interview, and body claim at the Mortuary@HSA located at Block 9, Outram Road.
trigger_conditions: Body of the deceased was conveyed to the Health Sciences Authority Mortuary (Mortuary@HSA) by police hearse.
Next-of-kin notified by SPF Investigation Officer to report to Mortuary@HSA the following morning.

immediate_actions.action: Up to two immediate family members (Next-of-Kin) arrive at Mortuary@HSA, Block 9, SGH Complex (11 Outram Road, Singapore 169078) by 08:00 AM.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Arriving late (after 09:30 AM) may cause administrative deferral of the autopsy review to the next working day.

immediate_actions.action: Register at the Mortuary@HSA security counter with original identification documents, the Police Case Slip, and medical history documents.
Enter the designated witness viewing gallery to perform visual identification of the deceased through the glass partition / high-resolution digital display.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Only immediate family members over 18 years of age are permitted in the formal identification room.

immediate_actions.action: Attend the formal interview with the Coroner's Police Officer and Forensic Pathologist to review medical history and discuss autopsy requirements.
Sign the release register, receive the Digital Death Certificate reference, and hand over the Body Claim Slip to the waiting Solace Dignity Care coordinator.

documentation_required.purpose: Mandatory identity cross-matching against Mortuary intake tags.
Establishes legal authority to claim human remains.

documentation_required.document_name: Police Investigation Slip / Case Information Card
documentation_required.purpose: Official reference admitting family to the Mortuary@HSA processing queue.

documentation_required.document_name: Deceased's Historical Medical Reports & Medication Lists
documentation_required.purpose: Crucial evidence for the Pathologist to determine if an invasive autopsy can be avoided.

documentation_required.document_name: SDC Letter of Authorization for Body Claim
documentation_required.purpose: Authorizes SDC licensed hearse drivers to receive the casketed body from the mortuary loading bay.

workflow_steps.description: Next-of-Kin meets SDC on-site liaison outside Block 9 Mortuary@HSA, registers at main counter, and receives queue token.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Queue call by Coroner's Police Officer.

workflow_steps.description: Family enters viewing gallery, views the deceased via secure glass partition, and confirms identity under formal caution.
Forensic Pathologist interviews family regarding recent health symptoms, hospital visits, and medications to finalize cause of death.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Completion of examination/autopsy and Coroner sign-off.

workflow_steps.description: Coroner's office uploads CCOD. Family downloads Digital Death Certificate via My Legacy and receives physical/digital Burial/Cremation Permit.

workflow_steps.phase: Mortuary Loading Bay Release to SDC Hearse
workflow_steps.description: SDC transfer crew presents claim documents at loading bay, receives remains, places body in casket/transfer pouch, and transports to embalming centre.

emergency_contacts.agency: Mortuary@HSA Main Reception Desk
Mortuary@HSA Secondary Helpline
Solace Dignity Care On-Site HSA Liaison Team

special_handling.notes: Solace Dignity Care stations a dedicated on-site funeral director at Block 9 HSA from 07:45 AM daily to guide families through the registration, emotional identification, and document handover.

procedures.title: National Digital Death Certification and ICA Registration Protocol (CCOD / My Legacy)
procedures.summary: Official technical and administrative workflow for digital Certificate of Cause of Death (CCOD) registration under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 2021 and My Legacy retrieval.
trigger_conditions: Clinical verification of death by a qualified registered medical practitioner or State Coroner.
Need to obtain official legal proof of death for funeral logistics, banking, insurance, CPF payouts, and probate execution in Singapore.

immediate_actions.action: Attending doctor or State Coroner accesses the MOH/ICA National Death Registration Portal and inputs the electronic Cause of Death Certificate (CCOD).
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Registered Medical Practitioner / Hospital Doctor / State Coroner
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Doctors must legally register the CCOD within 24 hours of verifying death under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 2021.

immediate_actions.action: The ICA Registry of Births and Deaths automatically registers the death within seconds and generates the official Digital Death Certificate PDF.
An automated system SMS / email notification with the retrieval reference is dispatched to the informant's Singapore mobile number.
Informant logs into the My Legacy portal (mylegacy.life.gov.sg) using Singpass credentials.
Download and save the official Digital Death Certificate PDF (secured with government digital signature and QR verification code), and share with Solace Dignity Care.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: The Digital Death Certificate must be downloaded and stored securely within 30 days of issuance.

documentation_required.purpose: Underlying clinical submission containing primary, antecedent, and contributory medical causes of death.
Secure authentication to access the My Legacy portal.

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA
documentation_required.purpose: Primary legal document replacing traditional physical paper death certificates for all legal, estate, and funeral purposes.

workflow_steps.description: Doctor completes medical cause of death input on national portal, matching deceased's NRIC/FIN with ICA registry records.
ICA system automatically registers death, cancels identity card in national registry, and compiles official digital certificate.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Dispatch of automated SMS to next-of-kin.

workflow_steps.description: Informant receives SMS alert with secure link to mylegacy.life.gov.sg.
Family downloads the signed digital PDF certificate and forwards it to Solace Dignity Care via WhatsApp / email.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Funeral director verification of QR code and watermark.

workflow_steps.description: Solace Dignity Care uses the digital certificate to book Mandai Crematorium, obtain Town Council wake permits, and file NEA clearances.

emergency_contacts.agency: ICA Registry of Births & Deaths Helpdesk
My Legacy LifeSG Technical Support
Solace Dignity Care Document Assistance Desk

special_handling.notes: Physical paper death certificates are permanently obsolete in Singapore as of 29 May 2022. The PDF downloaded from My Legacy is the definitive legal original. Solace Dignity Care verifies all digital watermarks to ensure instant permit approvals.

procedures.title: Critical 0-4 Hour Emergency Protocol and First Responder Action Checklist
procedures.summary: Time-critical decision matrix and chronological action plan covering the first 240 minutes following a bereavement in Singapore across all operational scenarios.
trigger_conditions: Initial 0 to 4 hours following the passing of a family member anywhere in Singapore.
Family requires immediate, unambiguous guidance on legal compliance, preservation, religious rites, and logistical coordination.

immediate_actions.action: Hour 0-1: Confirm cessation of life and do not move the body. Identify pathway: if hospital, alert ward nurse; if home natural, contact SDC 24/7 doctor dispatch (+65 6555 1115); if sudden/unnatural, dial SPF 999.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: DO NOT attempt to wash, dress, or move the deceased before clinical death certification is completed.

immediate_actions.action: Hour 1-2: Locate essential physical identification documents: Deceased's Original NRIC/Passport, Informant's NRIC, medical memos, and any pre-planned funeral / ACP wishes.
Hour 2-3: Facilitate CCOD submission by attending doctor/coroner, log into My Legacy with Singpass, and download the Digital Death Certificate.

Hour 3-4: Engage Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) to activate transportation crew, select wake venue (HDB Void Deck, Private Parlour, Landed Home, or Church/Temple Hall), and schedule embalming/casketing.
Hour 3-4: SDC funeral director files Town Council / Parlour permits, reserves Mandai Crematorium or cemetery slots, and coordinates wake tentage and utility hookups.

documentation_required.purpose: Primary verification of decedent identity.
Verification of informant authority.

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA (via My Legacy)
documentation_required.purpose: Prerequisite for booking wake venues, crematorium/burial slots, and body transport.

documentation_required.document_name: Town Council / HDB Void Deck Permit Application
documentation_required.purpose: Authorizes holding a wake at an HDB void deck and enables temporary power/water tapping.

workflow_steps.description: Establish medical vs. police pathway; summon attending GP, hospice doctor, or SDC 24-hour house-call doctor.
Doctor completes examination and submits CCOD. Informant accesses My Legacy via Singpass and downloads Digital Death Certificate.

workflow_steps.phase: 120-180 Mins: Funeral Director Handover & Logistics Briefing
workflow_steps.description: Solace Dignity Care transfer team collects remains. Family meets funeral coordinator to finalize wake venue, religious rites, casket selection, and cortege timings.
SDC secures Town Council void deck permits, books SP Services utility hookup, reserves Mandai Cremation slot, and erects wake enclosure.

emergency_contacts.agency: Solace Dignity Care 24/7 Rapid Emergency Response
Police Emergency (SPF)
SCDF Emergency Ambulance
NEA Mandai Crematorium Booking Office

special_handling.notes: Decisions made in the first 4 hours determine overall wake timing and logistics. Private parlour rooms (e.g. Sin Ming, Mount Vernon, Woodland Memorial) have strict booking cutoffs; SDC immediately locks in venue reservations upon activation.

procedures.title: Singapore Citizen / PR Death Abroad and Cross-Border Air Repatriation to SG
procedures.summary: Statutory and consular protocol for managing the death of a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident overseas, foreign death certification, NEA Port Health import permitting, and air repatriation to Singapore.
trigger_conditions: Singapore Citizen (SC) or Permanent Resident (PR) passes away outside Singapore (e.g., Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Australia, UK, USA, Europe).
Family desires to repatriate the physical body or cremated ashes back to Singapore for wake, funeral, or local niche placement.

immediate_actions.action: Contact the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission (Embassy, High Commission, or Consulate-General) or MFA Consular 24-hour Duty Office in Singapore (+65 6379 8800 / +65 6379 8855).
immediate_actions.critical_warning: MFA provides consular assistance, facilitates communications, and advises on local procedures, but statutory foreign funeral costs must be covered by travel insurance or the family.

immediate_actions.action: Register the death with the local civil authorities in the foreign country and obtain the official foreign Death Certificate (with certified English translation and apostille / embassy legalization).
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Next-of-Kin / Local Foreign Funeral Provider / MFA

immediate_actions.action: Appoint an international funeral director in the foreign jurisdiction to perform IATA-standard embalming, secure a hermetically soldered zinc-lined casket, and obtain local export clearances.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Foreign Funeral Director / SDC Global Partner Network

immediate_actions.action: Contact Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) to apply for the NEA Coffin Import Permit / Port Health Clearance and coordinate air cargo retrieval at Singapore Changi Airport (Changi Airfreight Centre).
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Solace Dignity Care / NEA Port Health

immediate_actions.action: SDC receives the casketed remains at Changi Airfreight Centre (CAC), completes ICA border clearance, and conveys the deceased to the Singapore funeral wake venue.

documentation_required.document_name: Official Foreign Death Certificate (with Certified English Translation)
documentation_required.issued_by: Foreign Civil Registry / Municipal Health Department
documentation_required.purpose: Primary proof of passing in the foreign jurisdiction.
Mandatory for airline cargo carriage under IATA Human Remains (HUM) rules.

documentation_required.document_name: Coffin Sealing & Hermetic Zinc Soldering Certificate
documentation_required.issued_by: Foreign Funeral Director / Port Health Authority
documentation_required.purpose: Verifies airtight sealing of zinc inner liner.

documentation_required.issued_by: Foreign Ministry of Health / Police / Customs

procedures.title: Death of a Foreign National in Singapore and Consular Clearance Protocol
procedures.summary: Legal and diplomatic procedure for foreign tourists, expatriates, work pass holders, and diplomats who pass away in Singapore, covering embassy notification, police clearance, and local disposition vs. outbound repatriation.
trigger_conditions: A foreign citizen (tourist, Employment Pass, S-Pass, Work Permit, student pass, dependent pass, or diplomat) passes away within Singapore territory.
Next-of-kin resides overseas or locally and needs to determine whether to cremate/bury locally in Singapore or repatriate the body back to the home country.

immediate_actions.action: Attending doctor or State Coroner certifies death and submits CCOD, generating a Singapore Digital Death Certificate referenced to the deceased's foreign passport and FIN number.
Notify the deceased's home country Embassy / High Commission / Consulate-General in Singapore immediately.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Foreign embassies require formal consular registration before issuing mortuary clearance or Letters of No Objection.

immediate_actions.action: Family or overseas legal representative appoints Solace Dignity Care (+65 6555 1115) through a notarized Letter of Authorization / Power of Attorney.

Determine pathway: If local cremation/burial is chosen, procure Embassy Letter of No Objection (NOC) and NEA Cremation Permit; if outbound repatriation is chosen, activate SDC international repatriation team.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Next-of-Kin / Foreign Embassy / Solace Dignity Care

immediate_actions.action: If deceased was an employment/work pass holder, notify the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and respective insurance providers to process statutory workmen compensation / repatriation insurance claims.

documentation_required.purpose: Primary identity verification and consular cancellation.

workflow_steps.phase: Option B: Full Body International Repatriation
workflow_steps.description: SDC performs arterial embalming, seals body in zinc-lined casket, obtains NEA export permit, and secures IATA HUM cargo flight booking.

special_handling.notes: If family cannot travel to Singapore, SDC acts as full legal proxy under a notarized power of attorney, handling hospital/HSA body claim, consular interviews, Mandai cremation, and insured ash repatriation back to the home country.

procedures.title: Outbound International Body Repatriation from Singapore Protocol
procedures.summary: End-to-end technical, regulatory, and aviation protocol for preparing, embalming, sealing, and air-freighting human remains from Singapore to any international destination worldwide.
trigger_conditions: Family, estate, or home government of a deceased person in Singapore requests outbound repatriation of physical remains to their country of origin for final rites and burial.

immediate_actions.action: Obtain official Singapore Digital Death Certificate and State Coroner / Police clearance (if case was coronial).
Perform advanced arterial embalming and restorative cosmetology in a licensed care facility by an internationally certified embalmer.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Solace Dignity Care Certified Embalming Staff
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Embalming is legally mandatory for international commercial air transport under IATA cargo regulations.

immediate_actions.action: Encase the remains in an airtight, hermetically soldered zinc inner liner, place into an approved solid timber export casket, and fit with an outer protective wooden crate/canvas.
Coordinate with destination country's Embassy / Consular Officer and NEA Port Health for physical casket inspection and consular wax sealing (if required by destination country).
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Foreign Embassy / NEA Port Health / Solace Dignity Care

immediate_actions.action: Apply for and secure the NEA Coffin Export Permit and Port Health Clearance Certificate.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Solace Dignity Care / NEA Port Health

immediate_actions.action: Book IATA HUM (Human Remains) air cargo space with commercial airline, clear cargo security at Changi Airfreight Centre, and dispatch flight airway bill to overseas receiving funeral director.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Solace Dignity Care Air Cargo Logistics Division

documentation_required.issued_by: Registry of Births and Deaths / ICA
documentation_required.purpose: Primary proof of death for export clearance.
Affidavit confirming full arterial preservation and non-infectious condition.
Certifies airtight zinc lining soldered in accordance with IATA and Port Health standards.
Statutory export authorization under the Environmental Public Health Act.

documentation_required.document_name: Consular Mortuary Certificate / Embassy Seal Certificate
documentation_required.purpose: Consular entry visa for human remains entering destination sovereign airspace.
Authorizes receiving funeral home to claim remains at destination airport.

documentation_required.issued_by: Airline Cargo Operator (e.g., Singapore Airlines Cargo, Emirates SkyCargo, Cathay Cargo)
documentation_required.purpose: Official international air freight manifest.

workflow_steps.description: SDC compiles death certificates, passport documents, and consular application forms for the destination embassy.
Certified embalmers perform complete arterial chemical preservation and restorative care.
Remains placed in zinc liner, soldered airtight, inspected with leak-detection protocols, and secured in outer shipping case.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Consular / Port Health visual sealing inspection.

workflow_steps.description: NEA Port Health issues export clearance. SDC books direct flight routing with temperature-controlled cargo hold.

workflow_steps.phase: Changi Airport Cargo Handover & Flight Departure
workflow_steps.description: SDC delivers casketed crate to SATS/dnata cargo terminal 4-6 hours before flight departure, completes security X-ray, and monitors tarmac loading.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Confirmation of wheels-up and arrival handover to overseas receiving director.

special_handling.notes: Solace Dignity Care maintains a 100% compliance record with IATA Human Remains (HUM) protocols and specific destination requirements (e.g. zinc solder witness ceremonies for Philippines, India, China, UK, and Australia).

procedures.title: Diplomatic Mission, Consular Seal, and Mortuary Clearance Protocol
procedures.summary: Diplomatic engagement and consular assistance guidelines for authenticating identity, obtaining consular seals, issuing mortuary passports, and coordinating cross-border funeral logistics with foreign embassies and high commissions in Singapore.
trigger_conditions: Deceased is a foreign national who passed away in Singapore, or remains/ashes are being transported across international borders requiring diplomatic validation.
Destination country mandates an official Consular Mortuary Seal, Consular Officer presence during casket sealing, or a formal Consular Mortuary Certificate.

immediate_actions.action: Establish direct contact with the Consular Section of the relevant Foreign Embassy / High Commission in Singapore.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Solace Dignity Care Consular Liaison / Next-of-Kin

immediate_actions.action: Submit complete consular documentation package: Singapore Digital Death Certificate, Embalming Certificate, Sealing Affidavit, Deceased's Original Passport, and Consular Application forms.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Incomplete documentation or lack of certified English translation will result in immediate consular processing delays.

immediate_actions.action: Schedule the physical Consular Sealing Inspection at Solace Dignity Care's care facility, where the Consular Officer verifies identity, inspects the zinc solder, and applies the official diplomatic wax seal and consular ribbon.
immediate_actions.responsible_party: Foreign Consular Officer / SDC Licensed Embalmer

immediate_actions.action: Consular Section cancels the deceased's foreign passport, affixes official consular stamps, and issues the Consular Mortuary Certificate / Mortuary Passport / Letter of No Objection.
Affix all original consular documents to the exterior shipping crate in an airtight document pouch for customs clearance at destination port of entry.
immediate_actions.critical_warning: Tampering with, breaking, or removing diplomatic seals during transit voids import authorization and results in quarantine confiscation at destination.

documentation_required.purpose: Consular identity verification, physical perforation, and official cancellation.

workflow_steps.description: SDC compiles all legal and medical documents, procures apostilles from Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) where required, and schedules consular appointment.
Consular officer attends SDC care suite, inspects decedent and zinc solder, closes outer wooden lid, and presses diplomatic wax seal across ribbon bands.
Embassy cancels deceased's passport, issues Mortuary Passport and NOC, and returns finalized dossier to SDC.
Sealed casket and diplomatic dossier transferred to Changi Airfreight Centre under secure diplomatic chain of custody.
workflow_steps.next_dependency: Final customs clearance at destination airport.
